start: ^Are you Li Jie? I will ask you about the case of fire in the ministry and the flowers of Wangchuan, tell only the truth and do not hide anything.

^Lord Arbiter! Was that my sister?? Her name is Li Xiaomei! No, it's the netherworld, my sister should not be here. Maybe I missed her too much I saw it wrong. It must be like this, it won't be my sister!

c-0: ^Ah…That person was your sister. She was also part of the case, died after you, and came to the netherworld for investigation.
^What!? No! That night didn't she go to the lantern show with her friends? Why would she be part of the case?
^Wait! Was it the revenge of that damn officer Xue Huaiyi!He……killed my sister!
^It was all my fault, I was too impulsive. I was busy being the hero, never thinking of the outcome, and caused my sister's death ……
^Lord Arbiter, please give justice to Xiaomei! Catch that damn Xue Huaiyi and take his life!
^Xue Huaiyi is also dead, I will tell you what happened.
^Xue Huaiyi is also dead, the things are more complicated than you think. Let me tell you what happened……
^!!!……How……So mamy things happened! Xiaomei……burned the ministry??
^Ah, but her life is only at the beginning……And the villagers……It's all my fault……
^……But, my sister is more couragous and determined than me! She did the things that I couldn't.
^Oh!! Lord Arbiter! There are still villagers who are sick! Please save them!
^The netherworld has already taken care of it.
^The netherworld has already taken care of it. But since you still couldn't let go, Black and White Spirit Wardens, take him to the Hometown-looking Platform.

^There, there! See? That is your village. Don't worry, Me and Black went there in a hurry, and took all the Yin Qi there. The villagers will be okay. But I was so tired! Who said that the netherworld was so scary, so that we have to work only at night. It's rumour! Rumour!
^Uhm! Li Jie, you saw, the villagers are getting better. As for the things after that, the netherworld will take care of it.
^Thank you so much lords! The suffering in the village can finally have an end……
^It's where our responsibility is! Let's go!

g-0: ^Never Mind! The fire has ended, the people are in the netherworld, the case is closed. I do not have any other thoughts, thank you Lord Arbiter!
^Okay, I will make my decision according to your crime. Do you have any objections?
